name: Victoria long rivers: 20 candidates
selectionNote: Provisional top-20 candidate set, not a certified length ranking. Full named rivers passing through or bordering Victoria, including the Murray; not clipped at the state border. Selection uses the WaterwayMap/OSM length list as a screening reference, excludes creek-named waterways and the NSW Wakool River, and includes the Campaspe as one river despite its split screening entries. Order is alphabetical, not rank. Screening lengths and boundaries can be incomplete; exact top-20 membership remains unverified. Geometry, measured lengths and resolution status come only from approved GeoXpl sources, not these selection references.
